definition: VOCALINA (보카리나) is a "text to speech" vocal synthesizer, it was the first music speech synthesis technology (Singing TTS Technology) to be developed focus on the Korean language and is focused on singing.
details: It is designed to be easy to use and produce high quality singing results.

explainer.lead: Vocalina is a Korean-language singing text-to-speech synthesizer, the first singing synthesis technology focused on Korean. It matters as an early dedicated singing-TTS system for that language.

tiers.eli5: It's a program that sings typed words out loud in Korean.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it to generate sung Korean vocals from text; its design goal is ease of use and high-quality singing output.
tiers.paperLevel: It is a singing text-to-speech synthesizer, converting text input into sung vocal audio for Korean; no further formal specification is given.

explainer.example: A user types Korean lyrics and Vocalina produces a sung vocal rendition.
